description: A REPRESENTABLE REFUSAL. Ships the held RefusalMark node -- the distinct token an ArgminRefusal (Rust Term idx 180) returns on a tie (a comparison matched nothing), reachable ONLY by a comparison-matched-nothing and never by a selection over ordinary values. A refusal becomes a first-class graph value: distinct from None (NOTHING), Bool(false) (NO), and any real winner (REAL). The hear-and-mint rule turns a heard refusal into a Residual node the gap-awareness / SelfConcern -> StandingConcern spine can promote and the teacher can ground (the NAMED successor).

attrs.note: the held refusal token; reference via Pick(NodesOfType(RefusalMark))

rules.name: refusal_query_mints_residual
rules.comment: HEAR a refusal (ArgminRefusal tie == RefusalMark) and MINT a Residual node the promote/ground spine can carry. Empty candidate set -> sel is None (NOTHING), not the token, so this does NOT fire on emptiness.
